content:
Context: 3. Journey fare for children studying at outstations

Admissible.To legitimate children/stepchildren/adopted children, who are studying in a recognized educational institution at a place in India away from the residence of the Government servant or his family. Not admissible if the children reside at the same place as the family is residing.
